$comment: THE SEAT REGISTRY (#6886 slice 1) and the org chart's source (Eric, 2026-11-07: an outline of our agentic systems as a company org chart, humans included, that also compacts context for agent workflows). One row per seat: a role that does work, filled by a lane, skill, agent, workflow, routine, gate, service, hook or person. `invoker` names what starts it (event · schedule · lane · session · member · eric · self · none); `none` means nothing calls it, which the page lists. A seat that pulls cards off the Orchestration board also carries `role` (the board's Role option, named by the job) and `pulls` (the labels whose cards sit in its queue); `roleOrder` lists those seats, first match wins (#6886 slice 1b, scripts/moneypenny/projects-role.mjs). `links` draw the picture between departments and people; `friction` records measured breakdowns on a communication edge (reverse Conway). Edit this file, then run `node scripts/org-chart.mjs` to rewrite docs/architecture/org-chart.md; tests/arch/org-chart.spec.ts fails on drift, a missing code root, or a roster file no seat covers.

friction.channel: the in-app chat (the dock under every page) and coach, filed as a GitHub issue
friction.what: Members almost never file from the app. One untested reading (Conway): the intake is shaped like the build team's issue capsule (app/src/live/moneypenny-filing.ts:30-34), not like play.
friction.number: 2 in-app filings since 2026-10-01 (#4861, #6007), both Eric's; the last other member filing is #716 (2026-08-28). Nearly all of the 238 feedback issues since 10-01 were filed by sessions under Eric's account
friction.change: Feedback becomes a game act: a one-tap reaction and a Suggest a change that knows the quest

friction.channel: the feedback status badge; the chat's work-status lookup
friction.what: A member hears back about their ask only by revisiting: no push about asks reaches them (trade alerts by email are opt-in).
friction.number: unmeasured (no member filings to measure against)
friction.change: 'Your ask shipped' becomes a moment on the landing page, with a Try it quest

friction.channel: the needs-eric label, then an assigned ask card
friction.what: Lanes send questions that are not his to answer; most clear later without him, so the real ones wait.
friction.number: 31 of 46 lane asks 09-26 to 10-26 were not decisions, 17 of them from conflict repair, since rerouted by #6010 (#6079); then 15 of 27 cleared without his answer, median ask 85h before #6953's fixes
friction.change: Ask 'only his?' before an edge points at Eric; a class whose predictions keep matching graduates (docs/process/ALIGNMENT.md)

friction.what: Lanes hand work to a live session, but no session is scheduled to read the label.
friction.number: 8 open on 2026-11-07, the oldest waiting 12 days, 1 of them from a repair lane; 5 after a live session cleared 3 (#7036)
friction.change: Staff it: a scheduled cloud routine pulls needs-session oldest first, or lanes may edit .claude/skills/ behind the envelope check

friction.channel: a push, a comment on #7024, a private steering page
friction.what: Several report pipes to one reader. The one he answered most, pictures with taps, needs a live session to publish.
friction.number: steering pages drew 87 answers 2026-10-10 to 10-16, then none (#6953); #7024's reply path has carried 0 replies (first edition due 2026-11-08)
friction.change: Shipped: the digest, steering page and newsletter read one source of 'needs you' (#6953). Still untracked: publishing the tap page from a routine

friction.channel: the admission gate's surface fence, which compares issue prose
friction.what: Two builds of the same code run at once; one is wasted and often lands in conflict repair.
friction.number: 3 of 3 closed lane PRs in the week to 2026-10-26 were superseded duplicates (#6250)
friction.change: Fence by the files a build will touch, not by its words

friction.channel: the App identity and the event router; every label and comment is an event
friction.what: In a surge hour the lanes' talk exhausts the App's hourly REST budget.
friction.number: 162 runs in one hour on 2026-10-27; 11 failed, 14 by 03:03Z, on the rate limit (#6319)
friction.change: Fewer, richer messages: the router skips events it will not act on; conditional reads

friction.edge: Live session → a running workflow agent
friction.what: Messaging a running workflow agent starts a second copy in the same worktree. The lesson lived in one machine's private memory.
friction.change: Workers read a file between steps; the lesson now sits in docs/DELEGATION.md rail 2, which CLAUDE.md sends every session to

friction.channel: an agent call, or a phrase from Eric
friction.what: Seats with no reporting line don't run, so the check each one stands for doesn't happen.
friction.number: review agents ran 4 times in 45 days (docs/review/README.md:10); the linguist 0 times (docs/COACHES.md:535); the debt coach only when a surge started it (7 cycles, 10-26 to 11-02, #4527)
friction.change: Every seat names its invoker or is benched; this page lists the ones nothing starts

friction.what: Lanes cannot create or regroup views, so each view change waits for Eric's click.
friction.change: Settle whether the API can; if not, one card with the clicks, once

friction.what: Loop checks sat unread on tracker #5724 until their decide step was routed (fixed 2026-10-26, scripts/loop-check.mjs); other lanes still post output only to tracker comments.
friction.number: 5 checks 4 to 16 days past due before the fix (2026-10-26)
friction.change: Re-run the loop census for the other tracker-comment outputs

target: Peers decide what is reversible and in-envelope; only the irreversible class and taste calls reach Eric, once, with a prediction.
The live-session department has staff on a schedule, so a hand-off never waits on Eric opening a laptop.
Members speak through play (reactions, quests, Try it) and hear back where they play.
Builds coordinate by the files they touch, and the lanes talk to GitHub in fewer, richer messages.
Every seat names what starts it; a seat nothing starts is benched or given an invoker.
